title: On the Relationship Between Semiring-Induced Valuation Algebra Isomorphisms and Semiring Isomorphisms
summary: This paper establishes a bidirectional relationship between isomorphisms of semirings and isomorphisms of their induced valuation algebras. We show that a semiring isomorphism is sufficient for a valuation algebra isomorphism. Conversely, for additively idempotent semirings without multiplicatively idempotent zero divisors, the existence of a valuation algebra isomorphism implies that the underlying semirings are isomorphic.
